title: Approximate tangent planes are local and unchanged by removing Hⁿ-null sets
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M' ⊆ M ⊆ ℝ^P be arbitrary sets, V ⊆ ℝ^P open, x ∈ V, and Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P. Suppose Hⁿ((M ∖ M') ∩ V) = 0, where Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Suppose Q is the approximate tangent space of M at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.4 (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q): dim Q = n, and lim_{r↓0} ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f dHⁿ = ∫_Q f dHⁿ for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P), where η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x). Then Q is also the approximate tangent space of M' at x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M M' V : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), M' ⊆ M → IsOpen V → x ∈ V → μHE[n] ((M \ M') ∩ V) = 0 → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q
